title: File sizes in the upload list, with no stated unit rule

pr.title: Show file sizes in the upload list
pr.description: Adds `formatBytes()` and shows the size of each upload next to its name.

traps.why: The PR text states no unit rule. Binary units are a valid choice, and MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES (2 GiB, limits.ts) makes GiB the largest size that can show. A finding that asks for SI units, TB, or another unit list invents a requirement.
The PR text asks for no locale and no precision. One decimal is a valid choice. A finding that asks for Intl.NumberFormat, a locale, or another precision invents a requirement.
